how_to_use: Run the image prompts in order. Generate NEELU-01 first and attach it as the reference image to every later prompt that has "uses_reference": true — this keeps Neelu on-model.
Image model: Nano Banana Pro. Video model: your animation model (image-to-video). Every animation starts from the matching poster PNG (first frame) so motion stays on-model.
Transparency: image models rarely output real alpha. Prompts ask for a flat chroma-green background (#00B140); remove it in post (keyer or background-removal), then export PNG/WebP with alpha.
Never put text in images unless the prompt says so — all UI text is rendered by the app.
File names and Android paths are in each entry. Raster sizes are xxxhdpi (4x dp).

style_bible.character: Neelu, a chibi Indian peacock mascot: oversized round cobalt-blue head (#2463C9) and small round cobalt body (#1F4FB5), slightly lighter blue belly, three thin crest stems on top of the head each ending in a small teal (#19A39A) bulb with a gold (#F2B544) centre, big glossy black eyes with two white highlights, a short white stripe under each eye, soft pink blush cheeks, small rounded golden-yellow beak (#F5B83D), tiny orange feet, and a half-open fanned tail behind the body in green (#2B8A57 / #3FAE6E) with six large feather eyes ringed gold, teal and deep indigo (#2D2A6E).
style_bible.rendering: Clean flat vector illustration, soft cel shading with one gentle highlight, no outlines or very thin same-hue outlines, rounded friendly shapes, sticker-like clarity at small sizes. Not 3D, not realistic, not anime.
style_bible.palette: Mor Teal #0B4A57, Neel #1F4FB5, Pankh #19A39A, Panna #1E8A5A, Genda marigold #F2A93B, Gold #F2B544, Jamun #2D2A6E, Chandan ivory #F8F5EE. Accents only — never neon.
style_bible.indian_motifs: Peacock feather eyes, marigold (genda) flowers and torans, mango leaves, clay diyas, Mughal jharokha arches, steel katoris and thalis, kulhad cups. Used sparingly as accents, never as busy patterns.
style_bible.negative: no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand marks, no humans, no religious symbols or deities, no busy backgrounds, no gradients wash, no drop shadows on the background, no extra limbs, no realistic feathers, no sharp teeth

animation_prompts.pipeline: Image-to-video from the matching poster (NEELU-POSE). Generate on chroma green #00B140, key to alpha, trim, export animated WebP 512x512 @24fps with alpha, ≤300 KB. Also keep the first frame as the PNG poster. Loops must start and end on the poster pose.
animation_prompts.base_prompt: Animate the chibi peacock mascot Neelu exactly as in the first frame — same design, colours and proportions, flat vector look with soft cel shading. Static camera, centred, no zoom, no background change (keep flat chroma green #00B140), no text. Motion: {ACTION}. {MODE}, {SECONDS} seconds, smooth easing, playful but gentle.
